mission.zh: 可溯源的中英双语 3D 网站、工具、引擎与生产流程技术档案
mission.en: Evidence-based bilingual atlas of 3D experiences, tools, engines and production workflows

summary.zh: 浏览器内运行的高拟真战机模拟器，公开十五篇工程制作笔记。
summary.en: A high-fidelity fighter simulator in a browser, accompanied by fifteen engineering notes.

strength.zh: 把真实地形、体积云、摄影镜头、六自由度飞控和声音整合成一致的飞行体验。
strength.en: Combines real terrain, volumetric clouds, camera optics, six-degree-of-freedom flight dynamics and audio into one convincing experience.

learning.zh: 研究时域体积云、四叉树地形 LOD、参数化飞机零件、输入/物理分离；完整游戏源码未确认开放。
learning.en: Study temporal volumetrics, quadtree terrain LOD, parametric aircraft parts and input/physics separation; full game source has not been verified as open.

summary.zh: 把作品集做成可驾驶、可碰撞和可探索的三维游戏。
summary.en: A portfolio transformed into a drivable, collision-enabled, explorable 3D world.

strength.zh: 开源了主循环依赖顺序、物理车辆、天气、音频、素材压缩与 Blender 工程。
strength.en: Shares game-loop dependency order, vehicle physics, weather, audio, asset compression and Blender sources.

learning.zh: 学习输入→固定物理→视觉→渲染的执行顺序，优化模型和纹理交付。
learning.en: Learn input → fixed physics → visuals → render scheduling and optimized model/texture delivery.

summary.zh: 以虚构消费品为主角的电影级交互式 3D 产品网站。
summary.en: A cinematic interactive 3D product experience built around a fictional consumer object.

strength.zh: 用有限的高品质物体、材质与镜头表现替代庞杂的页面堆砌。
strength.en: Uses a tightly art-directed hero object, materials and camera motion instead of a cluttered interface.

learning.zh: 研究产品特写、滚动叙事与光照层次；具体渲染栈待源码证实。
learning.en: Study product close-ups, scroll-directed storytelling and lighting hierarchy; render stack remains unverified.

projects.name: IVRESS — Spin a Tale
projects.upstream_license: Site proprietary; no reuse permission inferred

summary.zh: 面向品牌叙事的高品质三维交互作品。
summary.en: A polished, interactive 3D experience for brand storytelling.

strength.zh: 制作团队公开讨论 Three.js WebGPURenderer 与 TSL 的双渲染后端实践。
strength.en: Its makers discuss Three.js WebGPURenderer and TSL with a WebGL fallback path.

learning.zh: 研究同一节点材质在 WebGPU/WebGL2 之间的验证与降级策略。
learning.en: Study testing and fallback strategy for node materials across WebGPU and WebGL2.

summary.zh: 以沉浸式地形与场景漫游展现真实目的地。
summary.en: An immersive geographic and scenic exploration experience.

strength.zh: 把空间导览、景深与镜头节奏用于传达真实地域的氛围。
strength.en: Uses spatial navigation, depth and pacing to convey the atmosphere of a real destination.

learning.zh: 学习大尺度场景的镜头路线、空气透视与分级细节；技术栈未经源码核实。
learning.en: Study camera paths, atmospheric perspective and detail hierarchy in large worlds; stack is not source-verified.

summary.zh: 以冰材质与沉浸式互动塑造独特品牌视觉语言。
summary.en: An immersive brand site shaped around ice-like materials and interaction.

strength.zh: 统一材质主题和精确打光能形成强烈识别度，而不必堆积场景。
strength.en: A coherent material signature and precise lighting create identity without sprawling scenes.

learning.zh: 研究折射、粗糙度和环境反射的统一美术规范；内部 Shader 未验证。
learning.en: Study cohesive refraction, roughness and environmental reflection; internal shaders remain unverified.

summary.zh: 把品牌宣传转化成可操作的网页小游戏体验。
summary.en: Turns a brand campaign into a playable browser mini-game.

strength.zh: 短操作反馈和明确的交互目标比纯粹被动观看更容易建立参与感。
strength.en: Short feedback loops and clear player goals create participation beyond passive viewing.

learning.zh: 研究从进入、控制提示到核心玩法和分享的首分钟体验；不复制商标/美术。
learning.en: Study onboarding, input hints, the first-minute core loop and sharing; do not copy branding or artwork.

projects.name: Shopify Editions
projects.upstream_license: Commercial website; no license to copy

summary.zh: 用滚动章节和动效介绍大型产品版本更新。
summary.en: Uses scroll-driven chapters and motion to explain a major product release.

strength.zh: 在视觉叙事之外保留内容层级和可阅读文字，而不是让 3D 吞没信息。
strength.en: Preserves readable information architecture alongside visual motion instead of letting 3D overwhelm content.

learning.zh: 研究滚动时间线、性能降级和语义化页面的共存。
learning.en: Study scroll timelines, progressive enhancement and semantic content preservation.

projects.name: NASA Eyes
projects.upstream_license: US government data/site terms vary by asset; verify individually

summary.zh: 由科学数据驱动的太阳系、地球和航天任务交互式三维可视化。
summary.en: Interactive 3D visualizations of the solar system, Earth and missions driven by scientific data.

strength.zh: 真实信息与可探索空间结合，证明 3D 也可以是严肃的工具。
strength.en: Links authentic information to explorable space, showing that 3D can be a serious utility.

learning.zh: 学习分层数据、时间轴、轨道可视化与用户易读性；图像/数据授权逐项核查。
learning.en: Study layered data, time controls, orbit visuals and legibility; review data/image rights per source.

projects.name: Laarpi 3D Examples
projects.upstream_license: Examples are proprietary unless separately licensed

summary.zh: 展示参数化 3D 商品展示与工程表达的组合思路。
summary.en: Examples of combining parametric 3D products with technical presentation.

strength.zh: 让尺寸、二维规格与三维模型依赖同一个参数源，减少不一致。
strength.en: A shared parametric source can drive dimensions, 2D specification views and 3D models.

learning.zh: 学习参数映射与尺寸驱动的可靠交互；案例具体技术须单独验证。
learning.en: Learn parameter mapping and dimension-driven interaction; verify each case's technical implementation.

projects.name: AnyScene
projects.upstream_license: MIT code; generated models/service terms separate

summary.zh: 从参考图或文字 Brief 构建可重建的 Blender 场景、道具、灯光和镜头。
summary.en: Builds reproducible Blender scenes, props, lights and shots from references or a written brief.

strength.zh: 同一物件让两个生成器竞争，用同光照对比选优，再做几何接触和视觉纠错。
strength.en: Competes two 3D generators per prop, compares like-for-like renders, then checks contact and visual defects.

learning.zh: 学习资产清单、来源记录、脚本可重建场景、独立质量审查与 GPU 排队。
learning.en: Learn asset manifests, provenance, scripted rebuilds, independent visual critique and GPU queues.

summary.zh: 从风格参考生成同一美术语言的游戏道具套件。
summary.en: Creates cohesive production-oriented 3D prop kits from style references.

strength.zh: 逐件校准真实米制尺寸、朝向、原点、玻璃材质和 LOD，输出独立 GLB 与整套资产库。
strength.en: Normalizes real-world meters, orientation, origin, glass and LOD per prop; exports individual GLBs and a shared library.

learning.zh: 重点研究 normalize.py、模型对照、独立 critic 与可续跑的幂等请求。
learning.en: Prioritize normalize.py, model comparisons, independent critique and resumable idempotent jobs.

projects.name: AnyShot
projects.upstream_license: MIT code; cloud compute billed separately

summary.zh: 根据场景与自然语言自动规划摄影机、预览镜头并生成最终影像。
summary.en: Plans cameras from a 3D scene and language brief, previews shots and delivers graded imagery.

strength.zh: 镜头逐帧防穿模，先低成本预览再渲染，支持云端分片、缓存及恢复。
strength.en: Checks camera clearance frame by frame, blocks cheaply before final renders, and supports chunked rendering and resume.

learning.zh: 学习机位规划、镜头路径、深度焦点、异步帧块调度和可恢复任务。
learning.en: Learn shot planning, camera paths, rack focus, asynchronous frame chunks and retry safety.

summary.zh: 以原创视觉参考视频指导 Three.js 游戏制作和效果验收。
summary.en: Uses original reference videos to guide Three.js game creation and visual verification.

strength.zh: 把镜头/色彩/资产明确化，再通过并排画面对照和实际键盘试玩验证可玩性。
strength.en: Formalizes camera, palette and assets, then checks side-by-side images and actual keyboard play.

learning.zh: 学习视频到 SPEC 的转译、固定机位画面对比与操控测试。
learning.en: Learn video-to-SPEC translation, locked-camera visual comparisons and input-driven tests.

summary.zh: 面向图像转 3D 的工作台，组织多种生成后端和资产处理流程。
summary.en: An image-to-3D workbench orchestrating several generation backends and asset processing steps.

strength.zh: 将生成、缩面、纹理处理、Rig 和质量比较纳入可重复管线。
strength.en: Connects generation, decimation, texture processing, rigging and comparisons in a repeatable pipeline.

learning.zh: 先审显存、模型权重和第三方授权，再在小样本上验收实际 GLB。
learning.en: Audit VRAM, model weights and third-party rights, then validate real GLBs on a small sample.

summary.zh: 研究级图像转高质量三维资产模型，强调高保真几何与材质表达。
summary.en: A research-grade image-to-3D model emphasizing high-fidelity geometry and materials.

strength.zh: 提供高质量资产生成的技术基准，但算力门槛可能显著高于日常显卡预算。
strength.en: Offers a quality benchmark for asset synthesis while demanding substantial compute.

learning.zh: 参考官方硬件门槛，不把 16GB 显卡视为已经验证可稳定跑通。
learning.en: Respect documented hardware requirements; do not treat 16 GB GPUs as validated.

summary.zh: 把文本、图片或视频转换为可探索的三维场景表示。
summary.en: Turns text, images or video into explorable 3D scene representations.

strength.zh: 强调持久空间、可视化资产与独立碰撞网格的组合。
strength.en: Emphasizes persistent space and the pairing of visual assets with separate collision geometry.

learning.zh: 研究视觉层与物理层分离、成本、输出权属及场景质量稳定性。
learning.en: Study visual/physics separation, cost, output rights and scene consistency.

summary.zh: 面向 Three.js 的浏览器高斯泼溅渲染库。
summary.en: A browser Gaussian-splat rendering library for Three.js.

strength.zh: 可以把复杂扫描场景作为视觉层接入 Web 3D，再配合独立 Collider。
strength.en: Renders dense scanned spaces as a visual layer in Web3D while physics uses separate colliders.

learning.zh: 学习 3DGS 与 Mesh 共场景的遮挡、深度、排序和性能权衡。
learning.en: Study occlusion, depth, sorting and performance when mixing 3DGS with meshes.

summary.zh: 浏览器 3D 图形的核心开源 JavaScript 库。
summary.en: A foundational open-source JavaScript library for 3D graphics in the browser.

strength.zh: 场景图、相机、材质、动画和现代 WebGPU/TSL 路径都拥有成熟生态。
strength.en: Combines a mature scene graph, cameras, materials, animation and a modern WebGPU/TSL direction.

learning.zh: 理解渲染循环、资源缓存、LOD、Instancing、WebGL2 与 WebGPU 差异。
learning.en: Understand render loops, caches, LOD, instancing and WebGL2/WebGPU tradeoffs.

summary.zh: 建立在 Three.js 上、用 HTML 和实体组件系统制作 WebXR/VR 场景的框架。
summary.en: An HTML-first, entity-component framework for WebXR/VR scenes built on Three.js.

strength.zh: 使用声明式组件降低 VR 场景开发门槛，同时保留 Three.js 扩展能力。
strength.en: Makes immersive scenes approachable through declarative components while preserving Three.js extensibility.

learning.zh: 学习 ECS、组件复用、XR 输入映射与渐进式交互。
learning.en: Study ECS, component reuse, XR input mapping and progressive interaction.

summary.zh: 涵盖渲染、材质、动画、物理集成与编辑器生态的 Web 3D 引擎。
summary.en: A Web 3D engine covering rendering, materials, animation, physics integration and tooling.

strength.zh: 具有更完整的引擎式 API 与可视化调试工具，适合大型应用原型。
strength.en: Provides an engine-style API and rich debugging tools suited to larger applications.

learning.zh: 对照 Three.js 的场景管理与 Shader 工具链，评估跨引擎资产格式。
learning.en: Compare scene management and shader tooling with Three.js and assess cross-engine assets.

summary.zh: 专为 Web 实时交互设计的引擎，提供组件化运行时与可视化制作平台。
summary.en: A web-first real-time engine with a component runtime and visual production tooling.

strength.zh: 适合交互式商品、轻量游戏和多人协作式场景迭代。
strength.en: Suited to interactive products, lightweight games and collaborative scene iteration.

learning.zh: 学习分包加载、组件架构、压缩与浏览器端性能预算。
learning.en: Study chunked loading, component architecture, compression and web performance budgets.

summary.zh: 用 React 声明式组件组织 Three.js 场景。
summary.en: A React reconciler for declaratively building Three.js scenes.

strength.zh: 使 3D 场景与普通网站状态、路由和 UI 工作流更自然结合。
strength.en: Integrates 3D scenes with conventional website state, routing and UI workflows.

learning.zh: 学习 React 与实时渲染生命周期边界，避免高频状态触发不必要重渲染。
learning.en: Study React/render-loop boundaries and avoid costly high-frequency reconciliations.

summary.zh: 开放源码的建模、雕刻、绑定、动画、材质与渲染综合 DCC。
summary.en: An open-source DCC suite for modeling, sculpting, rigging, animation, shading and rendering.

strength.zh: Python 脚本与背景模式可把人工制作步骤转成可复现的生产流水线。
strength.en: Python automation and headless mode turn artistic operations into reproducible pipelines.

learning.zh: 研究资产标准化、批量处理、Rig 骨骼约束、Cycles 输出与脚本重建。
learning.en: Study asset normalization, batch processing, rig constraints, Cycles output and scripted rebuilds.

summary.zh: 跨平台的开源 2D/3D 游戏引擎，提供完整场景节点、动画和物理工作流。
summary.en: An open-source 2D/3D game engine with complete scenes, animation and physics workflows.

strength.zh: 对小团队的快速可玩性验证与非 Web 原生交付具有工程优势。
strength.en: Offers an integrated gameplay workflow for small teams and non-web-native builds.

learning.zh: 研究 GLB 导入、角色动画状态机与 Web 导出限制，不预设 WebGPU 网页可用。
learning.en: Study GLB import, animation state machines and web export limits; do not assume WebGPU web export.

summary.zh: 面向多平台实时互动、游戏与工业可视化的商业引擎。
summary.en: A commercial engine for multiplatform games, interactive experiences and industrial visualization.

strength.zh: 规模化资产导入、工具生态和可用插件众多，利于项目交付。
strength.en: Broad asset workflows and mature tooling support production delivery.

learning.zh: 研究 GLB/FBX 资产兼容和浏览器交付限制；授权费与条款按项目审核。
learning.en: Review GLB/FBX workflows and browser constraints; verify license terms per project.

projects.name: Unreal Engine
projects.upstream_license: Proprietary/EULA; source access is not open-source

summary.zh: 面向高保真大型三维场景、电影与复杂游戏的商业引擎。
summary.en: A commercial engine for high-fidelity worlds, cinematics and complex games.

strength.zh: Nanite、Lumen 和电影化内容生产为高品质资产标准提供参考。
strength.en: Nanite, Lumen and cinematic pipelines provide a reference for premium asset quality.

learning.zh: 研究资产尺度、PBR 和动作重定向；不能把源码可见等同 OSI 开源。
learning.en: Study asset scale, PBR and animation retargeting; source access does not mean OSI open source.

summary.zh: Rust 实现的高性能刚体、碰撞检测和查询物理库，带 JavaScript/WASM 生态。
summary.en: A high-performance Rust physics library with collision detection, queries and JS/WASM bindings.

strength.zh: 把真实碰撞与视觉 Mesh 分离，有助于消除穿模、滑行和动作错位。
strength.en: Separates collision physics from render meshes, reducing clipping and animation mismatches.

learning.zh: 学习固定步长、碰撞体、角色控制器和可重放测试。
learning.en: Study fixed timesteps, collider design, character control and replay testing.

summary.zh: Three.js 体系的地理空间渲染与大气相关技术集合。
summary.en: A Three.js geospatial rendering and atmospheric technology toolkit.

strength.zh: 能够研究真实地形、天空大气及体积云的分层实现方案。
strength.en: Offers a learning path for terrain, atmospheric sky and cloud-related rendering.

learning.zh: 重点核查各子模块 shader API、许可证与 Three.js 版本兼容。
learning.en: Review per-module shader APIs, license and Three.js compatibility.

summary.zh: 对 glTF/GLB 进行变换、检查、压缩与优化的工具链。
summary.en: A toolkit for transforming, inspecting, compressing and optimizing glTF/GLB.

strength.zh: 把纹理编码、网格压缩和批处理变成资产发布过程的一部分。
strength.en: Turns texture encoding, geometry compression and batch transforms into a release pipeline.

learning.zh: 建立 GLB 文件大小、材质兼容与视觉误差的自动验收。
learning.en: Build automated checks for GLB size, material compatibility and visual error.

summary.zh: 网格拓扑与索引优化、压缩和 LOD 的高性能基础库。
summary.en: A fast library for mesh topology/index optimization, compression and LOD.

strength.zh: 在画质可接受的前提下降低带宽、GPU 顶点处理和模型复杂度。
strength.en: Reduces bandwidth and vertex work while preserving acceptable visual quality.

learning.zh: 研究 gltfpack、Meshopt 解码与按距离动态 LOD。
learning.en: Study gltfpack, Meshopt decoding and distance-based LOD.

projects.name: VGGT
projects.upstream_license: Code and checkpoint licenses differ; commercial weights only where permitted

summary.zh: 从多视图图片恢复摄像机、深度和空间几何关系的视觉模型。
summary.en: A vision model recovering camera poses, depth and geometric structure from multi-view imagery.

strength.zh: 帮助把参考图连接到具有空间尺度的场景重建流程。
strength.en: Helps bridge reference images and spatially grounded scene reconstruction.

learning.zh: 研究镜头标定、COLMAP 数据出口；不可把输出当完整可玩 Mesh 或角色 Rig。
learning.en: Study camera calibration and COLMAP export; outputs are not automatically playable meshes or rigs.

projects.name: prompt2rig
projects.upstream_license: Apache-2.0 repo; SMPL-X/other weights separately restricted

summary.zh: 尝试从文本与动作视频自动生产角色动作并映射骨骼。
summary.en: A research pipeline for generating and retargeting character motion from prompts and video.

strength.zh: 把动作来源和骨骼映射流程模块化，为动画工厂提供候选输入。
strength.en: Modularizes motion sourcing and retargeting for an animation pipeline.

learning.zh: 验证关节方向、IK、手握武器与 Root Motion；不要仅凭视频外观判定动作正确。
learning.en: Test joint axes, IK, weapon grip and root motion rather than accepting a pretty preview.

summary.zh: 通过结构化游戏状态和可重复操作做游戏自动化测试。
summary.en: Automation tooling using structured game state and reproducible actions.

strength.zh: 将游戏状态、虚拟时间和动作轨迹纳入可验证的质量反馈循环。
strength.en: Makes game state, virtual time and action traces part of a repeatable QA loop.

learning.zh: 借鉴语义操作接口，不能未经验证声称工具直接支持所有 Three.js 游戏。
learning.en: Borrow semantic game testing ideas; do not assume it supports all Three.js games.
